# Mozy Construction

> Licensed general contractor with A Construction license (Florida CGC 1535189) providing full home renovation, kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, flooring, painting, pavers & outdoor living, sliding door repair, and handyman services in Central Florida (Orlando) and South Florida (Broward County, Miami).

Mozy Construction is a licensed and insured general contractor serving homeowners in Orlando, FL and the Broward/Miami metro area. We manage full renovation projects under contract — labor, materials, and permitting — as the general contractor of record.

## Company
- Legal/trade name: Mozy Construction
- License: A Construction license (Florida CGC 1535189), licensed and insured
- Service areas: Orlando / Central Florida; Broward County / Miami / South Florida
- Phone: (754) 271-6203
- Email: info@mozyconstructions.com
- Website: https://www.mozyconstructions.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/mozy_construction
